notes: secondary endpoint table: hsCRP change plus 0.39 plus or minus 2.55 (exenatide) versus plus 1.66 plus or minus 4.55 (insulin, asterisk for a within arm change), between arm p 0.183; both arms rose, the insulin arm more | STUDY: single centre randomised open label controlled trial, exenatide twice daily versus insulin aspart 30 twice daily in type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on oral agents, 66 randomised 1:1, full analysis set 27 versus 32, 52 weeks; primary endpoint carotid intima media thickness. This is the parent trial of group 149, the renal secondary analysis held under decision D-X8, and the two share this trial_id.
